subject: MAP: staged probe-kit handoff, sandbox rules, and takedown schedule
messages:
From: Brian Lee <blee@brightline.com>
To: chloe_martin, marissa_cole
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightline.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot probe-kit: timeline and constraints

Chloe / Marissa —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We are ready to move forward with a short pilot: a ~2 week run using the probe-kit/test-suite you showed. Before we exchange any materials, Brightline needs a brief MAP that spells out delivery windows, permitted uses (sandbox only), retention, and takedown obligations. Our DataOps lead (cc'd) will need the file formats and an expected ingest time so they can reserve a staging VM.

Top asks from our side:
- Staged delivery: seed samples (100 testcases) first, full probe-kit (1.2k cases) 3 business days after seed approval
- Sandbox only; no production training or model leaks beyond our team
- Audit log requirement and one-week auto-takedown after pilot end unless extended by mutual sign-off

Can you send a short MAP and the sample manifest this week?

Best,
Brian
Director, ML Ops
Brightline Retail

From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Brian Lee <blee@brightline.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightline.com>
Cc: marissa_cole, rafael_mendes
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot probe-kit: timeline and constraints

Brian — thanks, great to hear the team is ready. Attached is a MAP-draft that lines up with what we discussed and a small seed bundle (probe-kit_v1.zip, 100 items). High level summary in-line: 

- Week 0 (Day 0): NDA & MPA signatures (we can DocuSign)
- Day 1: Seed bundle delivered (100 testcases) + manifest CSV
- Day 3 after seed sign-off: full probe-kit delivery to your staging bucket (1,200 testcases)
- Usage constraints: sandbox-only, ephemeral access (no model training, no external redistribution), single Brightline project namespace in Redwood console
- Retention & takedown: 7-day post-pilot auto-takedown of artifacts; ability to request an export report prior to deletion
- Audit/logging: request for streaming audit log (tokenized) available for the pilot window; retention 30 days 

Attachments: MAP-draft-20270815.pdf, probe-kit_v1.zip

If DataOps needs an alternate format for the manifest (JSONL), Rafael can convert. Marissa and I will make the usage covenant explicit for sign-off. Would you prefer a single DocuSign envelope for MPA + MAP or separate instruments?

--
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Brian Lee <blee@brightline.com>, chloe_martin
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightline.com>, rafael_mendes
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot probe-kit: timeline and constraints

Thanks — quick redlines from our side after legal reviewed the MAP-draft: 

1) Clarify "no model training": we propose "no production model weight updates, fine-tuning, or continual training using the raw exchanged testcases"; allowed: offline quality analysis inside Brightline sandbox.
2) Add a clause for ephemeral dataset access tokens scoped to the Brightline project and auditable.
3) Takedown: propose 7-day auto-takedown plus a 30-day grace window for export if Brightline requests data export in writing.

Rafael — can you confirm the manifest JSONL sample for DataOps by EOD?

-Marissa
Principal Product, Redwood Inference

From: Sam Turner <s.turner@brightline.com>
To: marissa_cole, chloe_martin
Cc: Brian Lee <blee@brightline.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightline.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot probe-kit: timeline and constraints

Marissa / Chloe — legal quick note: the usage covenants look reasonable but we need two small edits before legal will sign: 

- Add an explicit prohibition on sharing raw testcases with third-party contractors without Brightline written consent (Brightline) — we can add reciprocal language that Brightline will not share Redwood-provided artifacts outside the pilot team.
- Retainability of audit logs: Brightline wants 90 days for audit logs instead of 30. We're flexible on dataset retention (7 + 30 grace is fine) but logs are important for internal compliance.

If you can accept those two items we can route for signature.

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Senior Counsel, Brightline

From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <s.turner@brightline.com>, Brian Lee <blee@brightline.com>
Cc: marissa_cole, rafael_mendes, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightline.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot probe-kit: timeline and constraints

Sam — thanks for the clarity. We can accept both edits with one minor adjustment: Redwood will provide audit logs (tokenized) for 90 days, and we will include a note that those logs contain no plaintext model parameters or user PII beyond request metadata. We will not share raw testcases with third parties unless both parties approve in writing.

I'll prepare a single DocuSign envelope including the MAP + MPA + the usage covenant with those two edits. Rafael will post the JSONL manifest by EOD and the seed bundle is attached to this thread for ingest.

Chloe
